name: Poligon Education Fund
mission: Poligon Education Fund (Poligon) is a national, nonprofit organization that fosters meaningful and long term relationships between the Muslim community, allies, and members of Congress. Poligon promotes positive policy change by teaching Congressional advocacy skills to the American Muslim community and educating policymakers on issues important to them such as Islamophobia, civil rights, and social, racial, and economic justice.

rich_narrative.summary: Poligon Education Fund is an advocacy group founded in 2017 that offers civic participation training to Muslim constituents and allies across the United States. The organization provides resources such as <cite id="6">town hall how-to guides</cite> and <cite id="7">office visit guides</cite> to empower individuals to engage with Congress. Operational metrics reflect an direct service delivery model with a low cost of $10.92 per beneficiary, serving approximately 12,000 individuals through programs like Action Alerts and Congressional Advocacy Trainings. However, no financial filings newer than FY2023 are available — donors should treat this 3-year-old financial picture with caution. The organization reported <cite id="3">$32,150 in annual revenue for FY2023</cite>, but spent <cite id="3">$131,029 in expenses</cite>, resulting in a deficit where expenses were 4.1 times revenue and working capital dropped to 0.5 months. Poligon maintains <cite id="2">zakat eligibility under the fisabilillah category</cite>, allowing donors to fund civic empowerment as a religious duty.
